result.title: Instance-Specific Classifier-Free Guidance for Text-to-Image Diffusion/Flow-Based Editing
result.summary: In recent years, a variety of prompt-based image editing methods have been developed based on text-to-image (T2I) diffusion/flow models. Image editing introduces an inherent trade-off between adhering to the original source image and realizing the change specified by the target prompt, which are typically measured by the LPIPS and CLIP-T metrics, respectively. Intuitively, this trade-off can be controlled by the classifier-free guidance (CFG) scale. Most existing editing methods, though, use a fixed CFG scale, ignoring that different edits require varying levels of modification. In this paper, we first explore the potential benefits of using an instance-specific CFG by exhaustively re-running prominent editing methods with a wide range of CFG scale values on benchmark datasets. We show that instance-specific setting can significantly improve LPIPS without compromising CLIP-T. Yet, tuning based on repeatedly executing an editing pipeline is inefficient. To prevent slow inference, we train a light-weight neural network that predicts the metrics of the underlying editing method for a given edit instance and CFG scale. At inference time, these predictions enable fast selection of an instance-specific CFG scale. Experiments across multiple editing methods and benchmark settings show the performance advantage of our approach over the baseline methods.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究文本到图像编辑中的实例级 CFG 缩放选择：通过在大范围 CFG 值上重复运行多种编辑方法，说明按实例设定 CFG 可在不牺牲 CLIP-T 的情况下明显改善 LPIPS，并训练轻量网络预测给定编辑实例与 CFG 下的指标，从而在推理时快速选出实例专属的 CFG。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用轻量预测器估计给定实例与超参下方法的指标、再据此选择控制量」的范式，可能为 LVR 中预测额外推理步骤或 LOOK/STOP 动作的收益与成本提供借鉴思路，但领域属图像编辑，是否真有对应决策结构可供核查。
